Guidance & outlook: During the year, we advanced towards our target of reducing carbon intensity by 25% by FY 2026-27 and achieving Net Zero status by FY 2029-30.

The fiscal deficit has been targeted at 4.3% of GDP, marginally lower than the 4.4% target for FY26, signalling the Government's ongoing commitment to fiscal consolidation while sustaining growth-oriented expenditure.
Q1 FY 2026-27: 2nd/3rd Week of July 2026 Q2 FY 2026-27: 2nd/ 3rd Week of October 2026 Q3 FY 2026-27: 2nd/3rd Week of January 2027 Q4 and Annual: FY 2026-27: 2nd/3rd Week of April 2027.
Growth & demand: Our flagship brand, Almond Drops Hair Oil, sustained its strong growth trajectory, delivering full-year growth in the twenties, outperforming the Company's overall growth while continuing to gain market share.

Building on a Phase 2 that added 363 channel partners and lifted reach by 9.5% across eight states, Aarohan markets continue to deliver a delta growth over non-Aarohan markets - evidence that disciplined execution on the ground translates directly into growth.

Affordable packs - sachets and low-unit-price offerings - remained powerful engines of volume growth, Hairoil is a $2 billion-plus category with 92% household penetration: mature, certainly, but with meaningful headroom for us to gain share, given our sub-10% presence today.
Margins & costs: EBITDA rose 70.9% to J224.4 crore, with margins expanding to 19.5%, and profit after tax grew 51.8% to J190.2 crore.
Gross margin expanded by nearly 660 basis points to 60.1%, and EBITDA grew 70.9% to H224.4 crore, lifting the EBITDA margin to 19.5%.
Further, core inflation declined to 4%, reflecting softer global commodity prices and easing input cost pressures.
Capex & expansion: The acquisition of a 49% stake in South India-based personal care company, with the remaining 51% currently in progress d.
Our capital expenditure stood at H32.62 Cr, while we remained net-debt free.

Despite these headwinds, global expansion was supported by strong investment in technology, particularly AI-led capital expenditure in North America and parts of Asia, along with accommodative financial conditions and targeted fiscal support.
Balance sheet & cash: During the year, your Company completed a share buyback of H186.6 crore while retaining a net-debt-free balance sheet - a combination that underscores both our confidence in the business and our steadfast commitment to creating long-term value for shareholders.
Total expenditure for FY27 is estimated at approximately ₹53.5 lakh crore, with non-debt receipts of over ₹36 lakh crore and net tax revenue of around ₹28.7 lakh crore.
